title: Honeymoon murder: Meghalaya High Court upholds trial court bail to accused wife
description: The Meghalaya High Court on Monday upheld a trial court order granting bail to Sonam Raghuvanshi, the Indore woman who was arrested last year for allegedly conspiring to murder her husband during their honeymoon in East Khasi Hills [State of Meghalaya v Sonam Raguvanshi].The Court was hearing the Meghalaya government's challenge to the April 27 order of the District and Sessions Court at East Khasi Hills, which had granted bail to Sonam after finding that the police had failed to effectivel
